verdict.rationale: Raygun documents exporting error groups from Crash Reporting and CSV exports aligned with filters, which are open formats, but this covers only error data, not a full account/data export across all products (APM, RUM, etc.) enabling a clean 'leave' with all data. Missing for 10: comprehensive full-account data export, documented open-format export for all product areas (APM, RUM, user tracking), and any explicit data portability/exit policy.
